description: Quote any pair across six routers (KyberSwap, LI.FI, Uniswap, 0x, SushiSwap, 1inch) without building a transaction. Returns the best amount out, already net of the TRNCH fee, and the router. Use it to compare before buying; to trade, call trnch_buy or trnch_sell instead. 409 if a token is not tradable through TRNCH. Requires the API key from trnch_register, sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

amountIn.description: Amount of tokenIn in its smallest unit (wei-style integer string).

decimalsIn.description: Decimals of tokenIn. Default 18: set it for USDG (6) and other non-18 tokens.

decimalsOut.description: Decimals of tokenOut. Default 18: set it for USDG (6) and other non-18 tokens.

slippage.description: Max slippage as a fraction (0.01 = 1%). Default 0.01.

tokenIn.description: Token sold: a 0x address or a Heat id.

tokenOut.description: Token bought: a 0x address or a Heat id.

name: trnch_quote
title: Quote a swap
